pages.name: Vienna Game: Heyde Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Nf3 with the queen on f3 and 0-0; plan 3 pushed d4-d5 into Black's d5-pawn. Rewrote plans 1 and 3 (Bd3/Bb5+, Nge2, g4 against f5, the e6 hole); British spelling in plans 2 and 4.

pages.name: KGD: Classical, 3.Nf3
pages.notes: Overview spoke of pressure on 'the weak f2 square' (empty after f4); plan 3 had an Nh4-f5 route; plan 4 named bare f2 and g3. Rewrote around the c5-bishop covering g1 (Nc3, Bc4, d3, Na4 or Be3 before castling); British spelling.

pages.name: KGD: Classical, 3.Nf3 d6
pages.notes: Plan 3 named an f2-pawn that isn't there; plan 4 had Na4 with the knight on b1 and b4 into the c5-bishop. Rewrote plans 3-4; British spelling in overview and plan 2.

pages.name: KGD: Classical, 4.c3 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 1 called the f-file semi-open with White's f-pawn on f4; plan 2 named White's d3 in a Black plan. Rewrote both plans (5.d4 exd4 6.cxd4 Bb6); British spelling in overview.

pages.name: KGD: Classical, 4.c3 Nf6 5.d4
pages.notes: Plan 3 had a3 against a ...Bb4 pin the b6-bishop can't make; plan 4 had the b6-bishop eyeing f2 through White's d4-pawn. Rewrote plans 3-4 (e4-e5; ...Nc6 and ...Bg4 against d4); British spelling and O-O in overview and plans 1-2.

pages.name: King's Gambit Declined
pages.notes: Overview and plans treated 3.fxe5?? Qh4+ as a sharp line; it loses at once: 4.g3 Qxe4+ wins the h1-rook and 4.Ke2 Qxe4 is mate (plan 2's Ke2-f2 was impossible). Rewrote overview and both plans.

pages.name: King's Gambit Declined: Classical, Soldatenkov Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a Rf3-g3 lift and 0-0 with the c5-bishop covering g1. Rewrote plans 1-2 (including the 5.Nxe5? Qd4 trap); plan 3 now says once castled; British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: King's Gambit Declined: Keene Defense
pages.notes: Plan 2 had Kh1 without castling and a semi-open f-file with White's pawn on f4; plan 1 had ...d6 then ...d5. Rewrote both plans; British spelling in overview.

pages.name: King's Gambit Declined: Panteldakis Countergambit, Schiller's Defense
pages.notes: Overview called the f8-bishop light-squared and spoke of threats to f2 (empty); plan 1 named an f2-pawn and 0-0. Rewrote overview and plan 1 around the c5-bishop covering g1.

pages.name: King's Gambit Declined: Panteldakis Countergambit, Symmetrical Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 targeted an f7-pawn that isn't there and, in the first rewrite, Bxf4 that loses a piece to ...Bxf4 (reviewer); plan 3 named bare e4 and d5. Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling in plan 4.
